description: For repos linted with typescript-eslint (e.g. via eslint-config-next). Extend as github>bjorntirsen/renovate-config:typescript-eslint

packageRules.description: Mirrors the typescript peer range of typescript-eslint. typescript-eslint only warns on an unsupported TypeScript, so CI would pass while its rules quietly degrade. Raise this ceiling only when typescript-eslint raises its own; every consuming repo follows.
